# OverflowMenu

The predictable home for secondary actions: a "More actions" button with an ellipsis that opens a keyboard-operable menu of grouped actions, destructive last.

`SongNodes.OverflowMenu` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.OverflowMenu actions={…} onSelect={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.OverflowMenu" actions="{{…}}" on-select="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (OverflowMenuProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | Button name; "More actions", or "More actions for <row>" on rows. |
| `actions` * | `MenuAction[]` | Items in order; destructive items go last. |
| `onSelect` * | `(id: string) => void` | Called with the chosen id; the menu closes and focus returns to the button. |
| `variant` | `"page" \| "row"` | Quiet small button for table rows. |
| `placement` | `"bottom-end" \| "bottom-start" \| "top-end" \| "top-start"` | Align or flip the menu. |

### MenuAction

One action shown in an OverflowMenu or ContextMenu.

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` * | `string` | Stable id passed back to onSelect. |
| `label` * | `string` | Verb-first label in sentence case, e.g. "Export as CSV". |
| `icon` | `string` | Lucide icon name from assets/Icons. |
| `shortcut` | `string` | Shortcut hint shown as a key cap, e.g. "F". |
| `disabledReason` | `string` | When set the item is aria-disabled and this reason is shown under the label. |
| `destructive` | `boolean` | Destructive: status-bad text, placed last after a separator; label ends with "…". |
| `checked` | `boolean` | Makes it a menuitemcheckbox with this checked state. |
| `group` | `string` | Group heading this item sits under, e.g. "Route". |
